title: What does YouTube advise students about bypassing AI-text detection tools? A pragmatic analysis
core_idea: Investigate how YouTube videos advise university students to use ChatGPT, with emphasis on methods recommended to bypass AI-text detection tools and on using ChatGPT as a study aid, by thematically analyzing transcripts from 173 videos.
tldr: The study thematically analyzes transcripts of 173 YouTube videos to characterize advice given to students about bypassing AI-text detectors and using ChatGPT as a study tool.
